correctness.rationale: Induced maximum degree at most one is equivalent to component size at most two, including the empty simplex. Independent exhaustive replay gave 72 wedge triples, 424 nonempty faces, and 211 disjoint matches; all 424 nodes in the 1,428-arrow directed Hasse graph sort topologically. Masks 2048 and 232 give one critical vertex and one critical 3-cell, proving S³ by the Morse CW model, not by modular ranks. Independent adjacency-preserving backtracking gave exactly eight automorphisms, all r^a s^b. On the original oriented simplex chains the signed fixed-face sum L gives 1-L on H3, yielding (-1)^a for all eight elements. On the prior ordinary-independence S² the sign is instead L-1, and the replay yields (-1)^(a+b). The quotient conclusion follows after barycentric subdivision, where simplex stabilizers are pointwise and rational averaging identifies homology of orbit chains with invariants. The nontrivial orientation line has none in positive degree; the quotient remains connected.
residual_risks: The verification concerns the labeled graph and specified reflection. It does not classify integral quotient torsion or equivariant homotopy. Frozen code was not executed; a compatible interpreter for it is Python 3.10 or later.
